Its main products are high-speed transmission connectors, card connectors, interface connectors, board connectors, press-fit connectors, IC sockets for mounting, other various connectors, and YFLEX (high-speed transmission cables and mounting boards); revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥24,742 million. Besides being manufactured by the company, the products are made by Prycon Microelectronics INC. (Philippines) and Yamaichi Electronics Deutschland Manufacturing GmbH (Germany), and sold by overseas subsidiaries.
entries.fb8d193ebb75d649: Headquartered in Minamikamata, Ota-ku, Tokyo, the company and its 15 subsidiaries form a group of 16 companies in total. Its main business is the manufacture and sale of mechanical components, including IC sockets used in semiconductor inspection processes and connectors for electronic and electrical equipment; the consolidated number of employees for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was 2,060. The company is listed on the Prime Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
